title: Finitely many n-covectors separate n-vectors
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ there are N ∈ ℕ and n-covectors b₁, …, b_N on ℝ^P (elements of Covector (Eucl P) n, the continuous alternating n-linear maps (ℝ^P)ⁿ → ℝ) such that every n-vector w (an element of NVector (Eucl P) n, i.e. a continuous linear functional on n-covectors) with w(b_i) = 0 for all i is the zero functional.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), ∃ (N : ℕ) (b : Fin N → Covector (Eucl P) n), ∀ w : NVector (Eucl P) n, (∀ i, w (b i) = 0) → w = 0
